_readme: THE PIXEL FLOOR'S KINDS (PLUMBER 10/19/26, row [the pixel floor], rule 105). Every picture the site publishes (slices/, engine/, records/target/) gets ONE kind from the first rule whose glob matches its path (* and ? stay inside one folder, ** crosses folders). A picture with no rule is red in THE PIXEL FLOOR: add a line here with its kind and why. Judged kinds have a floor in records/target/BOHEMIA_PIXEL_FLOOR.json (re-measured from his packs by tools/bohemia_pixel_floor.py --measure); the rest say where their things are judged. A folder holding rig.json is read first and apart (rig_ stills and DIRECTION's fin_ finish pass are the asset, else raw_, judged by the folder's BROADEST facing: a thing seen head-on is narrower than its long side; clip keys (_kNN) share their stills' canvas; shadow_, raw_, rigid, rigobj_, id_, obj_, calibration, riglight, normal_, mat_, mask_ are render passes; any other file falls to the rules), its kind from rig_kinds.
